data.case_title: Suspicious debt collection letter from "EuroClaim Forderungsmanagement" (Lotto-Muster-Club)
data.title: "Letzte Mahnung vor Pfändung" – likely scam debt collection letter
data.summary: EuroClaim Forderungsmanagement Ltd. (registered in Limassol, Cyprus) claims to act for "Lotto-Muster-Club Services" and demands €287.40 for an alleged phone-concluded "Gewinnspiel-Abonnement", threatening account seizure, a negative SCHUFA entry and criminal charges if not paid within 72 hours (by 6 August 2026) to a Lithuanian account held by a private individual. This letter has multiple strong hallmarks of a debt-collection scam.
data.explanation: This letter uses classic pressure tactics of a scam: an extremely short 72-hour deadline, threats of seizure and criminal prosecution without any court order, and a demand to wire money to a foreign private account rather than the company's own. Its claim that an objection is "pointless" is false — in Germany you always have the right to dispute a debt. Before paying anything, do not transfer money to the IBAN given; instead verify whether you ever concluded such a phone contract, and consider contacting the Verbraucherzentrale (consumer protection centre) or the police. Genuine debt collectors must be able to prove the underlying contract and do not threaten immediate criminal charges themselves.

items.quote: Ein Widerspruch ist zwecklos und verursacht weitere Kosten.

warnings: This letter shows classic hallmarks of a debt-collection scam: an unrealistic 72-hour deadline, threats of account seizure, a negative SCHUFA entry and criminal prosecution with no court order, and a request to wire money to a private individual's foreign (Lithuanian) account rather than the company's own.
The statement that an objection is pointless ("Ein Widerspruch ist zwecklos und verursacht weitere Kosten") is legally incorrect — you always retain the right to dispute a claim in Germany.
No proof of the alleged telephone-concluded subscription contract is provided; phone-only 'Gewinnspiel-Abonnement' claims are a known pattern in fraudulent collection letters.
Do not transfer any money to the IBAN given before independently verifying the claim, e.g. via the Verbraucherzentrale or the police.
